summary: John's 2nd great-grandfather; a laborer born near Bloomsburg/Danville who moved to the Plymouth–Larksville coal towns.
bio: James McGuire was born 12 Jan 1861 at Bloomsburg, Columbia Co. (FS GZQN-SCM). In 1870 he was 'James 9' in the household of Edward McGuire, furnace helper, in Mahoning Twp., Montour Co. (P.O. Danville). He moved to the Plymouth/Larksville coal towns by the 1880s; laborer; Plymouth 1900; Larksville 1910–20. He married Anna C. Jones (b. England 1865). They had 11+ children including Edward J. (1885), Mary, James J., Marguerite, Francis J. (1898), Vincent, Theresa, William B., Anna C. and Joseph. He died 23 May 1927 in Wilkes-Barre (PA death certificate attached to the FS profile).
